probes.check: After SDL_Quit, the facade's probe-build block tracking shows SDL released no block the facade didn't allocate; one it did fails the rule as ALLOC_HOOK_LATE(sdl3).

seeded_violation.description: Call SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_APP_NAME, "probe") before SDL_SetMemoryFunctions, so SDL allocates the hint with its default allocator and later frees it through the facade.

probes.check: am_probe_sdl3_allocation(): SDL_GetMemoryFunctions returns the four sdl3 trampolines, and the facade served SDL during the run.

seeded_violation.description: Remove the SDL_SetMemoryFunctions call from am_bind_sdl3_allocation().

adaptation_notes: SDL_SetMemoryFunctions must be the first call into SDL, before SDL_SetHint or SDL_SetAppMetadata (SDL_stdinc.h); the memory phase guarantees this as long as no game code calls SDL earlier. Set SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER through the environment, not SDL_SetHint, for the same reason.
SDL's hooks carry no user data or alignment, so the glue defines one set of trampolines that tag every block as SDL's.
Do not use SDL_GetNumAllocations as a probe: it returns -1 unless SDL is built with SDL_TRACK_ALLOCATIONS.
